candidate_note: No candidate yet. Every case is pending and the artifact block carries no digest, because no 4.1.0 image has been built: these are the only honest values for a release whose artifact does not exist. The case list is carried over from 4.0.0 -- what a release must prove does not change because the version did -- and every RESULT was dropped rather than copied. Three TITLES did have to change, and carrying them verbatim had already got them wrong: ISO-01 asked for "exact embedded 4.0 packages", PUB-01 for "the same verified 4.0 release", and UPGRADE-01 for an upgrade from 3.5, whose base image this host no longer has. A title is the requirement, so those three asked this release to prove the last one. verify refuses this manifest today, and should.
